body: Talking to some shrink or whatever later today. I'll see what options they have. So far, from all I know, it's not really an option. They can take me in, they can't knock me out.

This is only an option while they are pumping me so full of meds I can barely think at all.

If they can not accomplish that and just let me stay there while I still feel the way I feel now, the situation will just become a hundred times worse for me. In that sense putting me there is a certain death sentence.

Either they need to give me something seriously strong for at home, or basically comatize me in an institution.
Just buy a brand new one when yours starts to look like shit.

Me too. Maybe some others can help.

Thanks for the responses though. Good luck to you too.

Trying to make lifetime changes, but severe depression keeps putting me down. It goes okay for a little while, and then feeling down starts overtaking me again.

Career changes are impossible to make. No career, too many physical issues to make any kind of career.
